apps.message:
fix(app-page): drop the external-site note; name beimir.net as the founder's domain

## Intent

The note that lernapps.net takes no responsibility for privacy on an external site read like a stop sign right under the checked fitness note. The thanks and feedback addresses on beimir.net looked private, even like phishing. The app page should not raise doubts it cannot settle, and should say whose domain the addresses are on.

## Key changes

- The external-site note is gone. The privacy notice of lernapps.net still says that apps at their makers' own addresses are external sites.
- Under the thanks and feedback addresses, a note says that beimir.net is the founder's domain.
